description: Returns the full DESIGN.md for one website style reference (colour tokens, type scale, radius, buttons, layout notes, build prompt) plus its Tailwind v4 theme and CSS variables. Use this after search (kind styles) to build original work in that style; it is guidance, so do not copy the source site's logo, images, copy or trademarks. Does not spend credits and has no pagination. Read-only; an unknown slug returns an error pointing to search_styles.

slug.description: Style slug exactly as returned by search (kind styles), for example 'stripe'.

name: get_style_reference
title: Get a website style reference
